text:
maya: saw a spike of 429s on /v1/embeddings in eu-west at 13:12 UTC, small burst (~120 requests over 30s) from a customer test.
kevin: can you paste the logs? which lane was hit, emb vs rerank?
maya: logs show emb lane tokens exhausted, but rerank lane had spare capacity. suspect routing mismatch or admission config. snippet: ```ERROR 13:12:11 token_quota_exceeded lane=embeddings tenant=acct-42 req=0.45s```
raj: @maya do we have per-tenant softlimits split by lane or global? I thought we enforce token budgets per model-class.
maya: we do per-lane budgets but admission control seems to be summing at a higher level; the burst looks like many short embeddings requests (128 dim) that drove the emb lane into soft-throttle. rerank requests were queued behind the same admission gate.
kevin: hmm that would explain rerank being backpressured even though rerank GPUs were idle. can you confirm admission controller config? config snippet from prod: ```admission: mode: hierarchical gates: [global_budget, lane_budget] lane_budget: embeddings: 0.6 rerank: 0.4```
serena: the hierarchical design should allow lane-level preemption. if lane_budget exists, emb should not steal rerank tokens. maybe the global_budget kicked in and blocked everything.
maya: yes global_budget dipped during the burst and triggered a global backoff. but the global budget calculation uses a rolling-window with weight on token count which biases short high-QPS workloads.
raj: that's an interesting failure mode. options: 1) change aggregation to count weighted by GPU-seconds instead of tokens, 2) add fast-path for rerank when rerank GPUs idle, 3) split the global gate into region-scoped gates.
kevin: my vote for (2) + (3) short-term. add a quick heuristic: if lane_util(rerank) < 20% and lane_queue(rerank) > 0 then promote rerank admissions. avoids cross-lane starvation.
maya: implemented a temporary patch on staging: if rerank_util < 0.25 and emb_util > 0.8 then raise rerank_precedence. need to test edge cases.
infra-bot: autoscaler: detected emb_lane_surge eu-west 13:12-13:13, added 0 instances to emb pool (maxed).
serena: autoscaler hitting max is another root cause; if we can't scale emb, we should fall back to rerank-optimized variants or graceful degrade.
raj: long term we should decouple admission scoring: use model-cost predictions (GPU-ms) not token count. also consider per-tenant concurrent request caps at ingress so a single tenant can't spike global_budget.
kevin: agreed. can we roll the staging heuristic to prod in a controlled canary (10% users) and monitor 429 rate and rerank latency?
maya: I'll open a canary rollout PR, add metric dashboards: emb_429_rate, rerank_latency_p95, global_gate_fill.
serena: add a cost-signal too (estimated_gpu_ms) so we can A/B compare.
raj: timeline?
maya: PR in 30m, canary once green. will post updates here. :thumbsup:
kevin: thanks — also add an alert for "lane_idle_but_global_blocked" so SREs can triage faster next time.
infra-bot: alert created: lane_idle_but_global_blocked (severity=low)
maya: thanks, will follow up with postmortem if canary shows improvement.
